name: linear
description: Manage Linear issues, projects, and teams from Claude
long_description: This extension connects Claude to your Linear workspace, enabling issue creation, updates, search, and comment management through a standardized MCP interface. It uses the Linear SDK for reliable API interaction and supports common workflows like creating bug reports, searching for issues, and updating statuses.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in Linear

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for issues with flexible filtering

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue by ID

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the workspace

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects with optional team filtering

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue
